description: Scan an AI agent for security risks before it is deployed: dangerous tool permissions, prompt injection paths, exposed secrets, risky MCP servers, missing approval gates, SQL/SSRF/code-execution risks, and framework-specific issues (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK). Give a file or a folder; a folder is scanned as one report using the most important agent files (up to 60 files / 5MB). Returns a verdict, a 0-100 security score (higher is safer) and findings with file and line.

path.description: File or folder to scan. Relative paths are resolved from the current project.

name: scan_path
title: Scan agent files
